commands: set -e; echo BEFORE_CALL; adb shell dumpsys telephony.registry | grep -E 'mCallState=' | head -n 4; adb install -r app/build/outputs/apk/debug/app-debug.apk; APK=$(adb shell pm path pl.michalmatu.aicallbridge | head -n1 | sed 's/^package://'); echo APK=$APK; echo PROBE; adb shell "CLASSPATH=$APK app_process /system/bin pl.michalmatu.aicallbridge.ShellAudioProbe"; echo AFTER_CALL; adb shell dumpsys telephony.registry | grep -E 'mCallState=' | head -n 4
